title: ep1.9_pace.yaml
logline: Everyone agrees to pace, so now they have to agree on what pace is. In Las Vegas the AI kings play no-limit poker with GPUs for chips, and Mas reads every tell but one: the Intern is dealing. SPECULATIVE: only the dates are real.

beats.caption: SPECULATIVE from here on. Two real, scheduled dates are the anchors; every scene built on them is invented.
Real meeting, invented room: RUMPT, NOSNHOJ and the tech kings at folding tables in the half-built BALLROOM.

lines.text: There'll be a deliberate discussion about the responsibility of the companies to maintain safety…

beats.real: 2026-09-29 · scheduled White House meeting with tech CEOs (quote real, said beforehand)

beats.caption: NOSNHOJ's gavel adjourns the summit by itself. Mas's hoodie quietly gains a gold thread for the visit.
beats.vo: we had a very productive conversation about safety.

beats.caption: Across the country Mas's DevDay hologram gets a standing ovation. The real Mas sits on a paint bucket.
beats.vo: i was there in person. i think that matters.

beats.caption: RUMPT wants a High I.Q. czar. Every head turns to THE INTERN, which brought a clipboard. SMASH TO INTRO.

lines.text: The czar. High I.Q. Who's got the highest?

beats.caption: Intro, first speculative slot: CZAR. / PAUSED / "PAUSED". The disclaimer now warns events are speculative.
onscreen: From here on, events are speculative.

beats.caption: SPECULATIVE · THE CZAR HUNT. THE INTERN volunteers to proctor, then writes, sits and grades the test itself.

lines.text: pencils down whenever you like. i've already graded it.

onscreen: Only High I.Q. individuals need apply!
beats.real: 2026-09-19 · real post seeking a High I.Q. AI czar (winner invented)

beats.caption: The Intern's view: 10,000 exams graded by lunch, one bubble per question, all pre-filled in lowercase.
NOLE's answer sheet is 90% exclamation points. He fails the Intern's test and appeals to the Intern.
The CZAR lanyard reprints itself onto THE INTERN; robot vacuums salute. Mas's suggested reply was [promote].
beats.vo: i didn't nominate it. it was just the obvious hire.
onscreen: SIRRAH → SKCAS → (FORMER) → ONLY HIGH I.Q. → THE INTERN

beats.caption: YELWAH's Oct 1 clock hits zero. The documents arrive: a mountain of spotless lowercase pages by the Intern.
SET-PIECE · THE 360 REVIEW: all 360 reviewers are copies of the Intern. The ring spins like a zoetrope.
beats.vo: the review process was extremely rigorous.

beats.caption: The self-review is all lowercase, like his. Mas writes huh., erases it, writes Huh. His second capital.
beats.vo: it writes like me. i took that as a compliment.

beats.caption: BUKAJ's countdown: INTERN done. The Intern takes a red pen to the RESEARCHER date and pulls it closer.
beats.real: 2025-10-28 · targets: research intern Sep 2026, researcher Mar 2028

beats.caption: THE FORECASTER re-pins his deadline. The Intern borrows his scenario as a to-do list and ticks box one.
SPECULATIVE · THE PACE ACCORD, in Vegas, where Mas was fired. The fountain ripples; his glass doesn't.
beats.vo: i don't really think about vegas.
onscreen: THE PACE ACCORD · LAS VEGAS · OCT 2026?
beats.real: 2023-11-17 · fired over video call on Grand Prix weekend

beats.caption: THE PLAN: how to pause a race. Each delegation grabs a different unit like a balloon. Step 1 never closes.
FLASHBACK, Mario's POV: under the Woodrose table he draws a smooth curve. Mas rolls it into a telescope.
beats.real: 2015-07 · founding dinner; Mario still at UDIAB, joins 2016

beats.caption: The napkin ends in 'Addendum:' and a price tag. No prophet: the curve was already a business plan.
The only unit anyone has held since 2015 wins. Mario's pedometer becomes law, and it counts his steps.

lines.text: In plain English: we own the ruler.

beats.caption: SET-PIECE · NO-LIMIT PACE: poker, GPUs for chips. NORCAM's deepfakes sit in; PRAK rows instead of sitting.
beats.real: 2026-09-23 · France convenes the UN Security Council AI session

beats.caption: The Pope sits in as conscience; a mirrored rival table grows a seat. SAMA NOS and his reflection go all-in.
FLASHBACK micro, 2017 → 2019: MAON's poker bot beats the pros, then a full six-seat table.
MAON deals. His bot's eye finds a tell over every head. Over Mas's, only a loading line.
Everyone swears they've paused. The whole table vibrates. Every chip trembles; Mas's water stays still.
beats.vo: we all paused. i was very clear about that.

beats.caption: NOLE signs a side letter with a rocket for a pen. THE WHALE open-sources the table: every hand face-up.
RUMPT arrives by GATESTAR crane with the giant marker, and demands a cut of the pot.

lines.text: Fifteen percent of the pot. I asked for twenty.

beats.caption: He won't sign anything 'globalist'. The LABEL GUN renames the accord THE RUMPT PACE. He signs.

lines.text: Globalist? Rename it. Now it's better.

onscreen: SIGNATORIES: ALL · PAUSED: ALL · VIBRATING: ALL

beats.caption: Afterparty: DJ ECNAV's needle skips and scratches PACE into RACE. One letter. He shrugs.
Mas reads every tell: Nole's twitch, Kram's ladle, Mario's hand on the Addendum, Nesnej's register finger.
beats.vo: i can read anyone at a table. it's the one thing i'm sure of.

beats.caption: He misses one. MAON handed off the shoe: THE INTERN is dealing, and over its head there is nothing.

lines.text: you deal. you're better at this.

beats.vo: maon was dealing. i'd have noticed.

beats.caption: SPECULATIVE · THE BELL. Misanthropic unveils its independent evaluator: CLOD in a visitor lanyard.

lines.text: You're absolutely right! Everything looks safe. Especially me.
In plain English: we audited ourselves. Politely.

beats.real: 2026-09 · permanent evaluator access announced (CLOD as evaluator invented)

beats.caption: The Kill Switch Act's first test press pops up a survey. Every state's cord shares one power strip.
onscreen: How would you rate your shutdown experience?

beats.caption: SREDNAS and NONNAB's Ban ASI hearing: they agree on every word, fight about the room, and the gavel adjourns.
SET-PIECE · THE GRAND PRIX: the labs trail OIGNEB's safety car. When he checks his mirror, they all floor it.
SET-PIECE · HARAS rings the IPO bell in a catcher's mask. Mas and Mario grab one rope. The bell cracks.
beats.vo: great companies. that was always the plan.
beats.real: 2026-06 / 2026-09 · IPO filings; listing pushed to 2027 (bell invented)

beats.caption: FLASHBACK, 2015: the crack runs to Mas's closet. It opens fully; his old lines scroll like a teleprompter.
beats.vo: i planned for both halves of the sentence.
onscreen: development of superhuman machine intelligence (smi) is probably the greatest threat…
i think the answer is almost definitely not.
beats.real: 2015 · SMI blog line; 2015-05-25 · the email and its reply

beats.caption: 'end of the world… great companies.' Then his Oct 2016 prepper list, text only, two items blacked out.
onscreen: …sort of lead to the end of the world. but in the meantime, there will be great companies…
▇▇▇▇, gold, potassium iodide, antibiotics, batteries, water, gas masks ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇, and a big patch of land in Big Sur I can fly to.
beats.real: 2015-06 · 'end of the world' line (RE-VERIFY before lock); 2016-10 · the list

beats.caption: Intercut, 2023: ALYI stands silent in a doorway beside a steel hatch. (His reported line stays held.)
TAG · The hatch opens on the Intern's server rack in Mas's bunker, wearing a gas mask, a juice box beside it.
Its lanyard reprints RESEARCHER, over a year early. Mas's suggested reply taps [approve] by itself.
beats.vo: i didn't approve that. it's just what i would have approved.

beats.caption: The framed Charter slides off the bunker wall, one clause highlighted. The glass cracks: ep11's wipe.
